digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift workflow and Gerrit CI gating
propositions: terraform-drift.yml workflow does not run for Gerrit changes because it only triggers on pull_request or push to main, neither of which occur for Gerrit submissions
unapplied terraform resources can be committed and merged without detection because the drift check runs post-submit after the change is already in main
the Verified +1 gate provides no signal about whether committed terraform has been applied to infrastructure, creating a gap between code merging and infrastructure deployment
a terraform change adding resources passes all gates and is submitted even though those resources do not exist in the live environment until manually applied
the manual apply step is undocumented folklore rather than a required part of the landing process, making it easy to forget or skip
